$comment: Layout and policy for governance tooling. Consumers edit this file to adapt the portable infrastructure to their repository. Programme name and structure.required_paths are examples for lean-LLM-harness; change them for other programmes. See infrastructure/docs/methodology-scope.md.

context.$comment: Deterministic cold-session loading. AGENTS.md is loaded by the agent runner; front doors form the verified navigation graph. Target profiles are examples — consumers adapt directory patterns.

layout.$comment: Configurable paths. Consumers remap studies_root / notary_root / template_prefixes for their tree.

reproduction.$comment: Tier commands are explicit declarations. Certificate tier is optional for consumers with Lean certificates.

structure.$comment: DECLARATION of expected layout. Edit required_paths for your programme; do not derive from the filesystem. SMF physics docs are intentionally omitted — this is portable method infrastructure.
structure.living_path_prefixes_rationale: These surfaces may change without being treated as sealed scientific results.
structure.pin_exempt_path_prefixes_rationale: Hash pins enforce immutable experiment artifacts. Method docs and process automation are living.
structure.readme_only_roots_rationale: Scientific roots (if present) expose only README.md; governing rules live under infrastructure/.
structure.allowed_root_markdown_rationale: Agent runners and method surfaces at repository root.
structure.candidate_census_rationale: Optional for programmes that use CNN candidates. lean-LLM-harness uses lineage/techniques; leave pattern for consumer programmes.
structure.symbol_register_rationale: Optional programme vocabulary path. Consumers create the register when needed; checker stays under infrastructure/.
structure.sealed_corrections_rationale: Exact-path sanctions for sealed-study corrections. Empty for lean-LLM-harness scaffold.

policy.$comment: Executable restatements of method commitments. Keep when porting; adapt status vocabularies if needed.
policy.retrospective_rationale: infrastructure/research/research-method.md ranks retrospective fit lowest. A retrospective study may not report derived/supported.
policy.promotion_rationale: A claim asserting derivation or support must point at evidence or a cited source.
policy.new_claim_rigor_rationale: New claim IDs must expose assertion class, premises, falsifier, failure scope, and verification links.
policy.verification_plan_rationale: New gate-numerics and derivation protocols must declare decisive evidence kind before execution.
policy.freeze_rationale: Preregistration must be committed before decisive outcomes are viewed.
policy.conditional_implication_open_premise_rat: A conditional implication may not report derived/supported while a named premise remains open.

lineage_policies.summary: No technique may be adopted or adapted without a lineage record and registry entry.
METHOD.md must mention T-XXX for every adopted, adapted, or originated-here technique.
CI and scripts validate structure and consistency only; humans own scientific decisions.
PRs that change method surface or lineage must pass admit.py / pytest.
This repository excludes domain ontology and programme-specific experimental claims.
Consuming programmes pin sealed releases under releases/, not arbitrary living tips.
